notes.title: Hoover Heroes Brings the Fun to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/a6f4f4835e0765639b939d9b14ce4fbddee1ff14.png[/img]

[h3]🧹 The cleaners have arrived… and they’re here to cause trouble, Steam Next Fest is just the beginning![/h3]

[h2]🎉 What’s Waiting for You?[/h2]

[b]🫧 Play the Free Demo:[/b] Jump in and experience the thrill of outlasting your rivals in the ultimate cleaning showdown.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453620/Hoover_Heroes_Demo/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/e1d553312506dc56f86b7970918612c221f357bf.png[/img][/url]

[b]🌴 Get Messy in Paradise:[/b] Ready for a vacation? Too bad, it’s cleaning time! Battle your friends on the brand-new Island Map, where palm trees, surprises, and fun await. Sun, sand, and… flying coconuts? Yup, it’s all there! And the best part? The island fun doesn’t end with the Fest, it’s sticking around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/68524469005108489d08ee8bd627f9ef4bdf9d11.png[/img]

[b]💥 Unleash Your Inner Hoover Hero: [/b]Toss objects, push opponents, and land the perfect slap to stay in the fight!

[b]🚀 More Modes, More Madness:[/b] The full release will bring brand-new game modes, even wilder battles, and bigger messes to clean up!

[b]👥 Join the Community:[/b] Share your best moments, give feedback, and help shape the future of Hoover Heroes.

[url=https://discord.gg/kikigames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/83e6e783c13bae978ecad00651a7d804965689f5.png[/img][/url]

📅 Steam Next Fest: February 24th – March 3rd
🎮 Wishlist & Download the Demo on Steam!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453610/Hoover_Heroes/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/f2ca2bd1fd0a806763db43cd8b6f9ff6031c4f89.png[/img][/url]

The battle for Employee of the Month starts NOW. Will you claim the title?

notes.title: 🚨 Hoover Heroes Demo is OUT! 🚨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/217879c580fa7037a1b075e54edca9322a770458.png[/img]

Get ready for a whirlwind of chaos! 💨 

[h2]The Hoover Heroes demo is now available! 🎉[/h2]

[b]💥 Download now and jump into your first mission at the laundromat![/b]

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453620/Hoover_Heroes_Demo/
[b]
What’s in the Demo?[/b]
🌪 [b]Vacuum Power[/b] – Vacuum objects and launch them at your rivals!
✋[b] Slap Attack [/b]– Three quick slaps or one charged slap can send opponents flying!
🎯 [b]Dodge & Deflect[/b] – Avoid incoming attacks or smack projectiles away with air burst!
🏆 [b]Last One Standing [/b]– Outplay your rivals to become the Kevin Of The Month!

Gear up with your vacuum and dive into the madness! Sweep away the competition and fight to be the last one standing! We will be really  happy to see you in the reviews section.
[i]If you want to support us, don’t forget to add Hoover Heroes to your wishlist and stay tuned! [/i]

[b]Who will be the Kevin of the Month? Let’s find out! 😈✨[/b]
